summary: Comprehensive testing of CLOCKLN Remote Map feature completed successfully. All backend APIs (GET /api/reports/remote-workers, GET /api/reports/remote-clocks) working correctly. Frontend Remote Map page renders properly with Leaflet map, stats cards, and recent records list. Navigation from HR Dashboard to Remote Map and back works as expected.
passed_tests: GET /api/reports/remote-workers - returns remote/hybrid workers with locations
GET /api/reports/remote-clocks?days=7 - returns clock records with geolocation
Remote worker data includes required fields (id, name, email, work_mode, home_location, clocked_today)
Clock records include required fields (location, user_name, distance_from_home)
Authorization - non-HR users blocked from remote endpoints (403)
HR Dashboard - 'Mapa Remotos' button present and clickable
Remote Map page loads with Leaflet map container
Stats cards display correct counts (Funcionários Remotos, Ponto Hoje, Registros no Período)
Map legend shows color codes (Local cadastrado, Ponto dentro/fora do raio)
Recent records list shows Carlos Remoto with 90m distance badge
Days filter dropdown works (Hoje, Últimos 7 dias, Últimos 30 dias)
Remote worker badge ('Remoto') displayed in HR Dashboard employees list
